item.title: Fired Michigan coach Sherrone Moore remains in custody amid assault allegations
item.description: Former University of Michigan head football coach Sherrone Moore remains in custody after being arrested Wednesday evening, which came just hours after the school announced he had been fired for “an inappropriate relationship with a staff member.”
